issues.title: Incorrect slide counter value
issues.description: The carousel pagination displays an invalid slide count.
issues.evidence: The indicator reads 'شريحة 1 من 0' despite items being present.
issues.suggestion: Bind the total count to the active slide collection length.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: carousel.tsx never passed embla's `direction` option, so on RTL pages embla initialized as LTR inside an RTL flex container — scrollSnapList() returned [] (counter 'of 0') and canScrollPrev/Next were both false (arrows permanently disabled). Fixed by resolving direction (opts.direction > dir prop > closest [dir] ancestor) and passing it to embla; verified on /eval/pair-116: counter now 'شريحة 1 من 4', prev disabled/next enabled at slide 1, clicking next advances to 'شريحة 2 من 4'; vision re-audit of pair-116 no longer flags the counter.
